commands.name: build
commands.help: Build a LeRobot Pi0.5 or a documented openpi action policy

arguments.name: model
arguments.help: Hugging Face model ID or local snapshot

arguments.name: precision
arguments.help: TensorRT compute precision; defaults to BF16 for LeRobot or FP16 for openpi

arguments.name: quantization
arguments.help: Use FP8 weights and activations for the native BF16 LeRobot policy.

arguments.name: pi05_policy_config
arguments.help: Select openpi semantics explicitly; omit to retain the native LeRobot action contract.

arguments.name: edge_builder_python
arguments.help: Use this isolated Edge 0.12.0 Python builder when the installed runtime supports the requested openpi policy.
